objectives.summary: The Park Project aims to alleviate urban congestion and environmental impact by providing a mobile app that connects drivers with available parking spots. Key objectives include reducing circling time, idling, and CO₂ emissions, while enhancing user convenience through features like real-time spot sharing and a reward system.
key_points: The Park Project aims to reduce circling time, which contributes to inner-city congestion.
The project helps reduce idling and CO₂ emissions by matching drivers with available parking spots.
Every successful spot match decreases the number of cars looping the block.
The project aims to reduce city traffic and fuel waste through a peer-to-peer parking solution.
The goal is to make parking less of a concern for users, thereby giving them back their time.
The app includes features such as a map and list view of available parking spots and beta integrations with CarPlay, Android Auto, and Wear OS.
